text: I don't know. My training data ends around June 2026, so I have no record of Bitcoin's price on August 14, 2026, and I can't look it up in this conversation. CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, or an exchange's historical data page will have the exact close. Since Bitcoin trades 24/7, "closing price" usually means the 00:00 UTC daily close, but some sources use other cutoffs.
